title: INACTIVE originator stored string
_note: Parity vector transcribed from capture .softhouse/capture/origination/out/loan-originators-template-raw.json (GET /loan-originators/template, tenant gerege). request.name="INACTIVE" came from the capture statusOptions array entry "INACTIVE"; expect.stored="INACTIVE" is that same entry's string value. LoanOriginatorStatus is a STRING enum (no ordinal column): the oracle stores the enum name itself, declared in LoanOriginatorStatus.java:23-28 as INACTIVE("INACTIVE"). A wrong name-to-string mapping (e.g. INACTIVE stored as ACTIVE) silently corrupts every originator written and nothing throws.

provenance.note: Both fields are transcribed from the committed capture .softhouse/capture/origination/out/loan-originators-template-raw.json; capture_case_id names the statusOptions value of the observed entry.
